data.name: Colony on the Run
data.detailed_description:
Run. Multiply. Evolve.
Race through the human body in search of a place to call home!

Colony on the Run is a roguelite action-strategy game where you control a growing colony of bacteria struggling to survive inside the human body.

Your journey begins with just a single bacterium.

Vulnerable to heat. Vulnerable to cold. Vulnerable to dryness. Vulnerable to acids and alkalis.
Still, you multiply, evolve, and press onward in search of a place where you can finally live in peace.

■ Don't Fight. Run!

White blood cells are constantly hunting you down.

Guide your colony in real time, scatter when danger closes in, and dash away from pursuing enemies. Sometimes, a few bacteria may have to be sacrificed so the colony can survive.

You don't have to defeat every enemy.

Sometimes, running away is the best way to win.

■ From One Bacterium to a Swarm

Your journey begins with just one.

But as time passes, your bacteria multiply, growing into an enormous colony.

The more you multiply, the stronger you become. But grow too much, and the human body will notice.

How far should you multiply? When should you run?

Read the changing situation and keep your colony alive.

■ Evolve. Adapt. Survive.

Throughout each stage, choose from three randomly offered upgrades and evolve your bacteria.

Multiply faster. Move faster. Improve your toxins.

You can also absorb other bacteria you encounter to acquire new abilities.

How you evolve changes how you survive.

■ The Human Body Is Your Battleground

Travel through the throat, lungs, bloodstream, heart, brain, digestive tract, and beyond.

Every organ presents a different challenge. Get swept away by breathing in the lungs, carried by currents in the bloodstream, or pushed around by intestinal peristalsis.

White blood cells aren't your only threat.

The human body itself is trying to stop you.

Adapt to each environment and venture deeper and deeper inside.

■ Don't Fear Antibiotics

After three minutes, a massive wave of antibiotics sweeps across the stage.

Running alone won't be enough to survive.

Sometimes, you must expose your colony to antibiotics, sacrifice some of your bacteria, and develop resistance for the final onslaught.

Run. Multiply. Evolve.

Whatever it takes to keep the colony alive.

■ In Search of a Place to Call Home

If you don't multiply, you won't survive.
But multiply too much, and you'll harm your host—and destroy the very place you need to live.

Can stability and prosperity ever truly coexist?

A tiny colony of bacteria sets out on a journey through the human body, searching for a place where it can finally live in peace.

data.short_description: Start as a single bacterium, multiply into a colony, and race through the human body! Escape white blood cells, evolve, adapt to each organ, and survive the massive antibiotic wave after three minutes in this roguelite action-strategy game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU not required
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
